scope: Exact new button-version chooser, unified Download/Load controls, destination text nodes, handoff/errors, disabled loading notes and paired-sender prose; external-host disclosure and both source-confirmed built-in browser runtimes. Existing metadata/version templates and actual legacy option strings also checked.
limitation: This is a scoped language/runtime audit, not a whole-site translation or linguistic-quality percentage. No console service contacted, payload sent, page rebuilt or helper package changed.
